courses.title: 電力電子散熱設計
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究損耗、熱阻網路與暫態熱容量；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate losses, thermal networks and transient heat capacity. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設元件損耗 20 W，接面至冷卻液總熱阻 1.8 K/W，冷卻液 35°C，穩態接面估計 71°C；若損耗 30 W，估計 89°C。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 20 W device loss, 1.8 K/W total junction-to-coolant resistance and 35°C coolant: steady junction temperature is 71°C; 30 W gives 89°C.
workedExample.assumptions: 線性穩態近似，熱阻依安裝、流量與溫度而變；不把資料表 RθJA 當成任意機箱熱阻。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Linear steady approximation; resistance depends on mounting, flow and temperature. Datasheet RθJA is not arbitrary enclosure resistance.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

stages.title: 損耗與邊界
stages.description: 以三個技術單元逐一建立「損耗與邊界」的模型和可反駁的驗證證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units build models and falsifiable verification evidence for losses and boundaries.

steps.title: 損耗分解：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「損耗分解」建立可檢驗的模型，明確標出座標、變數、單位和有效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable model for loss decomposition, stating coordinates, variables, units and validity bounds.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。導通 I²R 與每次開關能量乘頻率是不同熱源；R 隨溫度改變。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「分別掃描電流和頻率，判別平方電流與頻率相關項。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Conduction I²R and switching energy times frequency are distinct heat sources; R changes with temperature. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Sweep current and frequency separately to distinguish quadratic-current and frequency-dependent terms. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.
steps.check: 提交「損耗分解」兩狀態圖、變數單位表和預期差異；以本步判別方法說明何種結果會推翻模型。
steps.checkEn: Submit two states, a variable/unit table and predicted differences for loss decomposition; specify which diagnostic result would falsify the model.
steps.observation: 分別掃描電流和頻率，判別平方電流與頻率相關項。

quiz.question: 審查「損耗分解」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for loss decomposition?
options: 導通 I²R 與每次開關能量乘頻率是不同熱源；R 隨溫度改變。
只有輸出功率決定晶片損耗。
室溫一定等於散熱器入口空氣溫度。
optionsEn: Conduction I²R and switching energy times frequency are distinct heat sources; R changes with temperature.
Output power alone determines die loss.
Room temperature always equals heat-sink inlet air temperature.

steps.title: 損耗分解：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「損耗分解」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。

steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Sweep current and frequency separately to distinguish quadratic-current and frequency-dependent terms. steps.observation: 分別掃描電流和頻率，判別平方電流與頻率相關項。
steps.observationEn: Sweep current and frequency separately to distinguish quadratic-current and frequency-dependent terms.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：只有輸出功率決定晶片損耗。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。

courses.title: 電力電子電磁干擾濾波
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究共模、差模與阻抗交互作用；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate common mode, differential mode and impedance interactions. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 教學 L=10 µH、C=1 µF 得 f₀≈50.3 kHz；僅在理想漸近區，頻率提高十倍多約 40 dB 衰減。
workedExample.textEn: Teaching values L=10 µH and C=1 µF give f₀≈50.3 kHz; only in the ideal asymptotic region does a tenfold frequency rise add about 40 dB attenuation.
workedExample.assumptions: 未包含來源與負載阻抗、ESR/ESL 或寄生共振；不得用此算例宣稱符合 EMC。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Excludes source/load impedance, ESR/ESL and parasitic resonances; the example does not establish EMC compliance.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

vendorHints.name: 德州儀器
vendorHints.role: 類比、電源與感測介面元件；以本課連結的原廠技術文件核對用途。
vendorHints.roleEn: Analog, power and sensing-interface components; check intended use in this course’s linked manufacturer documentation.

steps.title: 差模電流：模型與設計

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。去回導線中的等量反向高頻電流產生差模噪聲。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「對同一波形做和差分解，標記差模分量。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。

steps.title: LISN 與參考面：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: LISN and reference plane: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「LISN 與參考面」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in lisn and reference plane, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。對照既有測試資料的纜線、接地面與負載條件。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「LISN 提供規定的測試阻抗，量測配置是結果的一部分。」和待排除假說「不同測試佈置的數字可無條件直接比較。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Compare cable, ground-plane and load conditions in existing test records. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “A LISN supplies a defined test impedance; setup is part of the result.” with the hypothesis to reject “Numbers from different setups are unconditionally comparable.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：對照既有測試資料的纜線、接地面與負載條件。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Compare cable, ground-plane and load conditions in existing test records. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 對照既有測試資料的纜線、接地面與負載條件。
steps.observationEn: Compare cable, ground-plane and load conditions in existing test records.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：不同測試佈置的數字可無條件直接比較。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Numbers from different setups are unconditionally comparable. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

courses.title: 高精度類比訊號調理
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究微弱訊號、誤差預算與校準；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate small signals, error budgets and calibration. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設感測器滿刻度 20 mV、G=100，輸出跨度 2 V；輸入失調 10 µV 對應輸出 1 mV，為滿刻度 0.05%。
workedExample.textEn: Assume a 20 mV sensor span and G=100: output span is 2 V; 10 µV input offset becomes 1 mV output error, or 0.05% of span.
workedExample.assumptions: 線性小訊號且未飽和；固定誤差用界限和、獨立隨機誤差才可用均方根。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Linear small-signal operation without saturation; bound systematic errors and use root-sum-square only for independent random errors.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

vendorHints.name: 德州儀器
vendorHints.role: 類比、電源與感測介面元件；以本課連結的原廠技術文件核對用途。
vendorHints.roleEn: Analog, power and sensing-interface components; check intended use in this course’s linked manufacturer documentation.

stages.title: 訊號需求
stages.description: 以三個技術單元逐一建立「訊號需求」的模型和可反駁的驗證證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units build models and falsifiable verification evidence for signal requirements.

steps.title: 訊號與共模：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Signal and common mode: model and design
steps.objective: 以「訊號與共模」建立可檢驗的模型，明確標出座標、變數、單位和有效邊界。

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。差動毫伏訊號可以疊加在較大的共模電壓上。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「分別列出差模、共模與供應軌，不把輸出範圍當輸入範圍。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. A millivolt differential signal can sit on a much larger common-mode voltage. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: List differential, common-mode and supply ranges separately. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.

options: 輸出未飽和就表示輸入共模一定合法。

courses.title: 低雜訊放大器設計
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究雜訊匹配、增益與穩定性；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate noise matching, gain and stability. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設第一級 NF=1 dB、增益 15 dB，第二級 NF=8 dB，Ftotal≈1.427，總 NF≈1.54 dB。
workedExample.textEn: Assume first-stage NF=1 dB and gain=15 dB, followed by NF=8 dB: Ftotal≈1.427 and total NF≈1.54 dB.
workedExample.assumptions: 級聯公式以匹配、未壓縮的線性級為假設；輸入濾波損失需另列在第一級前。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Cascade calculation assumes matched, uncompressed linear stages; add input-filter loss ahead of stage one.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

1 dB 壓縮是增益偏離小訊號外推 1 dB，不是輸出下降到 1 dBm。
IP3 是可連續輸出的額定功率。
optionsEn: P1dB means output is limited to 1 dBm.
1 dB compression is a 1 dB departure from extrapolated small-signal gain, not 1 dBm output.
IP3 is a rated continuous output power.
quiz.explanation: 1 dB 壓縮是增益偏離小訊號外推 1 dB，不是輸出下降到 1 dBm。 畫出輸入輸出功率與線性外推線的差。
quiz.explanationEn: 1 dB compression is a 1 dB departure from extrapolated small-signal gain, not 1 dBm output. Plot input/output power and departure from the linear extrapolation.

steps.title: 壓縮：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「壓縮」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in gain compression, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。畫出輸入輸出功率與線性外推線的差。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「1 dB 壓縮是增益偏離小訊號外推 1 dB，不是輸出下降到 1 dBm。」和待排除假說「P1dB 代表輸出只能有 1 dBm。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Plot input/output power and departure from the linear extrapolation. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “1 dB compression is a 1 dB departure from extrapolated small-signal gain, not 1 dBm output.” with the hypothesis to reject “P1dB means output is limited to 1 dBm.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：畫出輸入輸出功率與線性外推線的差。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Plot input/output power and departure from the linear extrapolation. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 畫出輸入輸出功率與線性外推線的差。
steps.observationEn: Plot input/output power and departure from the linear extrapolation.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：P1dB 代表輸出只能有 1 dBm。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: P1dB means output is limited to 1 dBm. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

courses.title: 鎖相迴路頻率合成器
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究相位回授、雜訊整形與鎖定；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate phase feedback, noise shaping and lock acquisition. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設 fPFD=25 MHz、N=96，輸出 2.4 GHz；整數 N 改為 97，頻率變為 2.425 GHz。
workedExample.textEn: Assume fPFD=25 MHz and N=96: output is 2.4 GHz; N=97 gives 2.425 GHz.
workedExample.assumptions: 整數 N 且鎖定的理想關係；分頻器、VCO 範圍與參考相噪另行限制。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Ideal locked integer-N relation; divider limits, VCO range and reference phase noise impose additional constraints.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

courses.title: 高速類比數位轉換器
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究取樣、量化、時鐘與高速介面；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate sampling, quantization, clocks and high-speed interfaces. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設 fin=100 MHz、總 RMS 抖動 100 fs，抖動限制 SNR≈84.0 dB；fin 增至 200 MHz 降至約 78.0 dB。
workedExample.textEn: With fin=100 MHz and total RMS jitter of 100 fs, jitter-limited SNR≈84.0 dB; fin=200 MHz reduces it to about 78.0 dB.
workedExample.assumptions: 正弦、小時間誤差、抖動與輸入不相關；此值未包含量化、熱雜訊與失真。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Sinusoidal input, small timing errors and uncorrelated jitter; excludes quantization, thermal noise and distortion.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

courses.title: 精密數位類比轉換器
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究靜態線性、參考與動態建立；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate static linearity, references and dynamic settling. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.textEn: For a 16-bit DAC with Vref=4.096 V, LSB=62.5 µV; code 32768 gives 2.048 V and 65535 gives 4.0959375 V.
workedExample.assumptions: 理想直二進制單極傳遞；真實產品可能有增益、雙極映射、输出緩衝和保留碼。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Ideal straight-binary unipolar transfer; real products may include gain, bipolar mapping, buffering and reserved codes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

stages.title: 碼值與輸出
stages.description: 以三個技術單元逐一建立「碼值與輸出」的模型和可反駁的驗證證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units build models and falsifiable verification evidence for codes and outputs.

steps.title: 碼制與端點：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Coding and endpoints: model and design
steps.objective: 以「碼制與端點」建立可檢驗的模型，明確標出座標、變數、單位和有效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable model for coding and endpoints, stating coordinates, variables, units and validity bounds.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。2ᴺ 個碼的最高碼是 2ᴺ−1，因此理想滿碼低於 Vref 一個 LSB。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「檢查零碼、中碼與滿碼的期望值。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. With 2ᴺ codes the highest is 2ᴺ−1, so ideal full-scale code is one LSB below Vref. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Check expected zero, midscale and full-scale-code values. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.
steps.check: 提交「碼制與端點」兩狀態圖、變數單位表和預期差異；以本步判別方法說明何種結果會推翻模型。
steps.checkEn: Submit two states, a variable/unit table and predicted differences for coding and endpoints; specify which diagnostic result would falsify the model.
steps.observation: 檢查零碼、中碼與滿碼的期望值。
steps.observationEn: Check expected zero, midscale and full-scale-code values.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：16 位滿碼等於 65536。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: The largest 16-bit code is 65536. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

knowledge.title: 課程量化模型與適用界限
knowledge.titleEn: Course quantitative model and validity limits
knowledge.text: 理想單極 DAC：Vout=Vref·D/2ᴺ；D=0…2ᴺ−1。 理想直二進制單極傳遞；真實產品可能有增益、雙極映射、输出緩衝和保留碼。
knowledge.textEn: Ideal unipolar DAC: Vout=Vref·D/2ᴺ; D=0…2ᴺ−1. Ideal straight-binary unipolar transfer; real products may include gain, bipolar mapping, buffering and reserved codes.

quiz.question: 審查「碼制與端點」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for coding and endpoints?
options: 2ᴺ 個碼的最高碼是 2ᴺ−1，因此理想滿碼低於 Vref 一個 LSB。
電流輸出 DAC 對端點電壓沒有任何限制。
optionsEn: With 2ᴺ codes the highest is 2ᴺ−1, so ideal full-scale code is one LSB below Vref.
The largest 16-bit code is 65536.
A current-output DAC has no terminal-voltage limit.
quiz.explanation: 2ᴺ 個碼的最高碼是 2ᴺ−1，因此理想滿碼低於 Vref 一個 LSB。 檢查零碼、中碼與滿碼的期望值。
quiz.explanationEn: With 2ᴺ codes the highest is 2ᴺ−1, so ideal full-scale code is one LSB below Vref. Check expected zero, midscale and full-scale-code values.

steps.title: 碼制與端點：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Coding and endpoints: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「碼制與端點」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in coding and endpoints, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。檢查零碼、中碼與滿碼的期望值。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「2ᴺ 個碼的最高碼是 2ᴺ−1，因此理想滿碼低於 Vref 一個 LSB。」和待排除假說「16 位滿碼等於 65536。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Check expected zero, midscale and full-scale-code values. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “With 2ᴺ codes the highest is 2ᴺ−1, so ideal full-scale code is one LSB below Vref.” with the hypothesis to reject “The largest 16-bit code is 65536.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：檢查零碼、中碼與滿碼的期望值。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Check expected zero, midscale and full-scale-code values. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 檢查零碼、中碼與滿碼的期望值。
steps.observationEn: Check expected zero, midscale and full-scale-code values.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：16 位滿碼等於 65536。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: The largest 16-bit code is 65536. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

Voltage- and current-output DACs impose different load and compliance requirements. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。單調代表碼增加時輸出不反向，並不代表每一步都等大。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「掃描相鄰碼增量的最小值。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。

Form a falsifiable prediction using: Scan minimum adjacent-code increments. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.

knowledge.text: 理想單極 DAC：Vout=Vref·D/2ᴺ；D=0…2ᴺ−1。 理想直二進制單極傳遞；真實產品可能有增益、雙極映射、输出緩衝和保留碼。
knowledge.textEn: Ideal unipolar DAC: Vout=Vref·D/2ᴺ; D=0…2ᴺ−1. Ideal straight-binary unipolar transfer; real products may include gain, bipolar mapping, buffering and reserved codes.

quiz.question: 審查「量測解析力」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for measurement resolution?
options: 測短路本底與長時間漂移，再報可分辨範圍。
更多平均必能消除長期參考漂移。
optionsEn: Measure shorted-input noise and long-term drift before reporting resolvable limits.
More averaging necessarily removes long-term reference drift.
The largest 16-bit code is 65536.
quiz.explanation: 驗證微伏步階需要比被測誤差更低的儀器噪聲與穩定性。 測短路本底與長時間漂移，再報可分辨範圍。
quiz.explanationEn: Microvolt-step verification requires instrument noise and drift below the target error. Measure shorted-input noise and long-term drift before reporting resolvable limits.

courses.title: 射頻功率放大器
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究射頻功率、效率與線性；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate RF power, efficiency and linearity. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設輸出 10 W、輸入 0.1 W、直流輸入 25 W，PAE=39.6%；汲極效率為 40%，兩者不同。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 10 W output, 0.1 W input and 25 W DC input: PAE=39.6%; drain efficiency is 40%, a different metric.
workedExample.assumptions: 同時刻平均實功率，未含外部供電轉換損耗；不等於整機效率。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Average real powers measured consistently; excludes external supply-conversion losses and is not complete-system efficiency.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

steps.title: 功率與 dBm：模型與設計

steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable model for power and dbm, stating coordinates, variables, units and validity bounds.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。dBm 是相對 1 mW 的對數功率，不可直接當瓦相減。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「把 30 dBm、20 dBm 轉成瓦再算效率。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. dBm is logarithmic power relative to 1 mW and cannot be subtracted as watts. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Convert 30 and 20 dBm to watts before calculating efficiency. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.
steps.check: 提交「功率與 dBm」兩狀態圖、變數單位表和預期差異；以本步判別方法說明何種結果會推翻模型。

steps.observation: 把 30 dBm、20 dBm 轉成瓦再算效率。
steps.observationEn: Convert 30 and 20 dBm to watts before calculating efficiency.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：PAE 可用 dBm 差值除以直流瓦數。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。

steps.title: 功率與 dBm：量測與判別

steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。把 30 dBm、20 dBm 轉成瓦再算效率。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「dBm 是相對 1 mW 的對數功率，不可直接當瓦相減。」和待排除假說「PAE 可用 dBm 差值除以直流瓦數。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Convert 30 and 20 dBm to watts before calculating efficiency. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “dBm is logarithmic power relative to 1 mW and cannot be subtracted as watts.” with the hypothesis to reject “PAE can divide a dBm difference by DC watts.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：把 30 dBm、20 dBm 轉成瓦再算效率。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Convert 30 and 20 dBm to watts before calculating efficiency. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 把 30 dBm、20 dBm 轉成瓦再算效率。
steps.observationEn: Convert 30 and 20 dBm to watts before calculating efficiency.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：PAE 可用 dBm 差值除以直流瓦數。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: PAE can divide a dBm difference by DC watts. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。核對 Pin、Pout、PDC 和散熱估計的總和。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「功率計、頻譜分析與直流量測須在一致參考面閉合能量帳。」和待排除假說「效率超過 100% 只是高性能的表現。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Cross-check Pin, Pout, PDC and estimated dissipation. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “RF power, spectral and DC measurements need consistent reference planes to close the energy balance.” with the hypothesis to reject “Efficiency above 100% simply indicates high performance.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：核對 Pin、Pout、PDC 和散熱估計的總和。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Cross-check Pin, Pout, PDC and estimated dissipation. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 核對 Pin、Pout、PDC 和散熱估計的總和。
steps.observationEn: Cross-check Pin, Pout, PDC and estimated dissipation.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：效率超過 100% 只是高性能的表現。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。

courses.title: 射頻濾波器與雙工器
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究聲學濾波、損失與收發隔離；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate acoustic filtering, loss and transmit/receive isolation. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 教學通帶中心 2 GHz、3 dB 頻寬 100 MHz，載入 Q≈20；若 abs(S21)=0.794，插入損耗約 2.00 dB。
workedExample.textEn: A teaching passband at 2 GHz with 100 MHz 3 dB bandwidth has loaded Q≈20; abs(S21)=0.794 corresponds to about 2.00 dB insertion loss.
workedExample.assumptions: 單一近似帶通的載入 Q；不可等同材料本徵 Q，也不是特定商用品數據。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Loaded Q of an approximate single bandpass; not intrinsic material Q or a commercial product specification.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

quiz.question: 審查「功率承受」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for power handling?
options: 低功率 VNA 曲線足以證明任意發射功率適用。
聲學器件的熱與非線性限制大訊號操作。
溫度補償表示所有溫度完全零漂移。
optionsEn: A low-power VNA curve proves suitability at any TX power.
Thermal and nonlinear behavior limit acoustic-device large-signal operation.
Temperature compensation means zero drift at every temperature.
quiz.explanation: 聲學器件的熱與非線性限制大訊號操作。 比較小訊號插損與高功率下的漂移記錄。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal and nonlinear behavior limit acoustic-device large-signal operation. Compare small-signal loss with high-power drift records.

steps.title: 功率承受：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「功率承受」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in power handling, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。比較小訊號插損與高功率下的漂移記錄。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「聲學器件的熱與非線性限制大訊號操作。」和待排除假說「低功率 VNA 曲線足以證明任意發射功率適用。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Compare small-signal loss with high-power drift records. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Thermal and nonlinear behavior limit acoustic-device large-signal operation.” with the hypothesis to reject “A low-power VNA curve proves suitability at any TX power.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：比較小訊號插損與高功率下的漂移記錄。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Compare small-signal loss with high-power drift records. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 比較小訊號插損與高功率下的漂移記錄。
steps.observationEn: Compare small-signal loss with high-power drift records.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：低功率 VNA 曲線足以證明任意發射功率適用。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: A low-power VNA curve proves suitability at any TX power. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。中心頻率與材料溫度係數相關，補償結構仍有剩餘誤差。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「繪製頻帶邊界跨溫位移。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Center frequency follows material temperature coefficients; compensated structures retain residuals. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Plot band-edge movement across temperature. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.

Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.

steps.observation: 保存校準面與溫度條件下的完整掃頻。

steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：只量一個中心頻點可代表全部通帶。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。

courses.title: 天線阻抗匹配網路
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究阻抗、輻射效率與環境失諧；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate impedance, radiation efficiency and environmental detuning. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設 50 Ω 系統接 100 Ω 純電阻，Γ=1/3，VSWR=2，反射功率比 1/9≈11.1%。
workedExample.textEn: A 100 Ω resistive load in a 50 Ω system gives Γ=1/3, VSWR=2 and reflected-power fraction 1/9≈11.1%.
workedExample.assumptions: 單頻、實數參考阻抗；良好匹配不表示高輻射效率。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Single frequency and real reference impedance; good matching does not imply high radiation efficiency.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

options: 測試纜線不可能成為天線的一部分。
校準一次之後更换纜線也無需重查。
不平衡饋電可能讓量測纜線參與輻射。
optionsEn: A test cable cannot become part of the antenna.
Changing cables never requires rechecking calibration.
Unbalanced feeding can make the measurement cable radiate.
quiz.explanation: 不平衡饋電可能讓量測纜線參與輻射。 改纜線走向，觀察方向圖與阻抗是否一起改變。
quiz.explanationEn: Unbalanced feeding can make the measurement cable radiate. Change cable routing and inspect pattern/impedance changes.

steps.title: 饋線共模：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Feedline common mode: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「饋線共模」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in feedline common mode, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。改纜線走向，觀察方向圖與阻抗是否一起改變。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「不平衡饋電可能讓量測纜線參與輻射。」和待排除假說「測試纜線不可能成為天線的一部分。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Change cable routing and inspect pattern/impedance changes. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Unbalanced feeding can make the measurement cable radiate.” with the hypothesis to reject “A test cable cannot become part of the antenna.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：改纜線走向，觀察方向圖與阻抗是否一起改變。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Change cable routing and inspect pattern/impedance changes. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 改纜線走向，觀察方向圖與阻抗是否一起改變。
steps.observationEn: Change cable routing and inspect pattern/impedance changes.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：測試纜線不可能成為天線的一部分。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: A test cable cannot become part of the antenna. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

courses.title: 軟體定義無線電前端
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究混頻、IQ 誤差與數位射頻協同；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate mixing, IQ errors and analog/digital co-design. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 教學 RF=915 MHz、LO=910 MHz，差頻 5 MHz；若 LO 改 920 MHz，實數頻差仍 5 MHz，但理想 IQ 的頻率符號相反。
workedExample.textEn: For RF=915 MHz and LO=910 MHz the difference is 5 MHz; LO=920 MHz also gives a 5 MHz real difference but reverses the ideal IQ frequency sign.
workedExample.assumptions: 理想混頻與固定 IQ 符號約定；真實系統含鏡像、直流偏移及 LO 洩漏。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Ideal mixing with a fixed IQ sign convention; real systems contain images, DC offsets and LO leakage.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

options: IQ 頻率符號與資料排列無關。
輸入已知偏移正弦，確認頻譜方向。
抽取倍數可任意增加且永不混疊。
optionsEn: IQ frequency sign is independent of data ordering.
Use a known-offset tone to verify spectral orientation.
Decimation can increase arbitrarily without aliasing.
quiz.explanation: 複數訊號的 I+jQ 或 I−jQ 約定改變頻率方向。 輸入已知偏移正弦，確認頻譜方向。

steps.title: 取樣鏈：模型與設計

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。類比濾波、ADC 取樣與數位抽取需共同配置。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「逐級標示可用頻寬與混疊區域。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Analog filtering, ADC sampling and digital decimation need joint configuration. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Mark usable bandwidth and alias zones at each stage. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.

steps.title: 取樣鏈：量測與判別

courses.title: 高密度互連電路板
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究微孔、增層與高密度逃線；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate microvias, buildup and dense escape routing. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 教學微孔介電深度 60 µm、入口直徑 100 µm，AR=0.60；此比值是幾何比較，不是通用合格門檻。
workedExample.textEn: A teaching microvia 60 µm deep with 100 µm entry diameter has AR=0.60; this is a geometric comparison, not a universal acceptance limit.
workedExample.assumptions: 錐形微孔、鍍填和材料可靠度需另外驗證；所有尺寸為假設。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Taper, fill plating and material reliability need separate verification; all dimensions are assumed.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

courses.title: 軟硬複合電路板
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究彎曲應變、材料與剛柔交界；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate bending strain, materials and rigid-flex transitions. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設均質薄片 t=0.10 mm、R=10 mm，外表面應變約 0.5%；真實多層銅與膠的中性軸需重算。
workedExample.textEn: For a homogeneous sheet t=0.10 mm and R=10 mm, outer-surface strain is about 0.5%; real copper/adhesive multilayers need a recalculated neutral axis.
workedExample.assumptions: 小應變幾何近似，不是銅疲勞壽命或允許彎曲半徑規格。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Small-strain geometric approximation, not a copper fatigue-life or allowable-radius specification.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

courses.title: 表面黏著生產線
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究錫膏、貼裝與生產線資料閉環；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate paste, placement and production-line feedback. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 教學開口 0.30×0.40 mm、鋼網厚 0.10 mm，理論體積 0.012 mm³；量得 0.0096 mm³ 則轉移效率 80%。
workedExample.textEn: A teaching aperture 0.30×0.40 mm with 0.10 mm stencil gives 0.012 mm³ theoretical volume; 0.0096 mm³ measured means 80% transfer efficiency.
workedExample.assumptions: 矩形幾何近似，不含壁錐、錫膏流變和量測不確定度；不是製程目標值。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Rectangular geometry excludes wall taper, paste rheology and measurement uncertainty; not a process target.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

courses.title: 選擇性焊接與回焊控制
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究潤濕、熱曲線與焊點形成；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate wetting, thermal profiles and joint formation. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設 2 g 銅件、cp=385 J/(kg·K)、升溫 150 K，顯熱約 115.5 J；不含焊料熔化和散熱。
workedExample.textEn: For 2 g of copper, cp=385 J/(kg·K) and a 150 K rise, sensible heat is about 115.5 J; solder melting and losses are excluded.
workedExample.assumptions: 定比熱與均溫假設；不可作為實際爐溫或焊接時間配方。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Constant heat capacity and uniform temperature; not an oven-temperature or soldering-time recipe.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

courses.title: 自動光學電路板檢測
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究三維量測、誤報與缺陷回饋；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate 3D measurement, false calls and defect feedback. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假想 100 個真正缺陷中找出 95 個，另誤報 20 個：recall=95%，precision=95/115≈82.6%。
workedExample.textEn: Of 100 hypothetical true defects, 95 are found with 20 false calls: recall=95%, precision=95/115≈82.6%.
workedExample.assumptions: 需有獨立真值標記；不把此示例當任何檢測設備性能。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Requires independent ground truth; these values do not represent any inspection machine.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

quiz.question: 審查「照明與反射」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？

最亮的區域必然最高。

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。結構光或多視角高度需校準幾何，遮蔽會留缺測。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「標出重建置信度及無資料區域。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Structured-light or multiview height requires geometry calibration; occlusion leaves gaps. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. steps.observation: 標出重建置信度及無資料區域。

steps.title: 三維重建：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「三維重建」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in 3d reconstruction, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。標出重建置信度及無資料區域。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「結構光或多視角高度需校準幾何，遮蔽會留缺測。」和待排除假說「所有可見像素都自動具有可靠高度。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Mark reconstruction confidence and missing-data regions. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Structured-light or multiview height requires geometry calibration; occlusion leaves gaps.” with the hypothesis to reject “Every visible pixel automatically has reliable height.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：標出重建置信度及無資料區域。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。

courses.title: 電路板邊界掃描測試
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究TAP 狀態、結構測試與覆蓋邊界；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate TAP states, structural tests and coverage limits. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設總掃描鏈 1,200 bit、TCK=5 MHz，一次移位約 240 µs；100 個向量純移位時間約 24 ms。
workedExample.textEn: For a 1,200-bit chain at 5 MHz TCK, one shift takes about 240 µs; 100 vectors require about 24 ms of shifting alone.
workedExample.assumptions: 忽略 TAP 切換和等待；時鐘速率必須受所有鏈上元件規格限制。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Excludes TAP transitions and waits; clock rate must satisfy every device in the chain.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

Boundary scan verifies controllable/observable connections, not complete functional behavior. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. quiz.question: 審查「BSDL 對應」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for bsdl matching?
options: 相同系列的任意 BSDL 都可互換。
BSDL 必須對應器件、封裝與版次的掃描結構。
交換兩器件順序不影響向量解讀。
optionsEn: Any BSDL in a product family is interchangeable.
BSDL must match device, package and revision scan structure.
Swapping device order does not affect vector interpretation.
quiz.explanation: BSDL 必須對應器件、封裝與版次的掃描結構。 核對腳位映射、指令長度與 ID。
quiz.explanationEn: BSDL must match device, package and revision scan structure. Check pin mapping, instruction length and ID.

steps.title: BSDL 對應：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「BSDL 對應」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in bsdl matching, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。核對腳位映射、指令長度與 ID。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「BSDL 必須對應器件、封裝與版次的掃描結構。」和待排除假說「相同系列的任意 BSDL 都可互換。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Check pin mapping, instruction length and ID. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “BSDL must match device, package and revision scan structure.” with the hypothesis to reject “Any BSDL in a product family is interchangeable.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：核對腳位映射、指令長度與 ID。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Check pin mapping, instruction length and ID. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 核對腳位映射、指令長度與 ID。
steps.observationEn: Check pin mapping, instruction length and ID.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：相同系列的任意 BSDL 都可互換。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Any BSDL in a product family is interchangeable. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

courses.title: 電子組件靜電防護
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究帶電、放電路徑與防護稽核；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate charging, discharge paths and control audits. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 教學 C=100 pF、V=1 kV，Q=100 nC，E=50 µJ；這僅示範電容儲能，不是完整 ESD 波形。
workedExample.textEn: For teaching C=100 pF and V=1 kV, Q=100 nC and E=50 µJ; this illustrates capacitor energy, not a complete ESD waveform.
workedExample.assumptions: 集中電容近似；峰值電流還取決於放電路徑 R、L 和事件模型。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Lumped-capacitance approximation; peak current also depends on discharge-path R/L and event model.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

vendorHints.name: 德州儀器
vendorHints.role: 類比、電源與感測介面元件；以本課連結的原廠技術文件核對用途。
vendorHints.roleEn: Analog, power and sensing-interface components; check intended use in this course’s linked manufacturer documentation.

courses.title: 汽車電子環境耐久驗證
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究任務剖面、加速模型與失效分析；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate mission profiles, acceleration models and failure analysis. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設 Ea=0.7 eV、使用 85°C、應力 125°C，k=8.617×10⁻⁵ eV/K，AF≈9.8；僅對相同主導機制的模型成立。
workedExample.textEn: Assuming Ea=0.7 eV, use at 85°C, stress at 125°C and k=8.617×10⁻⁵ eV/K gives AF≈9.8, only for the same dominant mechanism.
workedExample.assumptions: 示例 Ea 並非通用常數；不可把此倍率直接轉成汽車電子壽命保證。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Example Ea is not universal; do not turn this factor directly into an automotive lifetime guarantee.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

options: 十個樣本沒壞就證明全產品永不失效。
寫出樣本數、停止規則與未發現失效的界限。
測試末端功能正常就表示中途從未失效。
optionsEn: Ten passing samples prove all products never fail.
Record sample count, stopping rule and limits of zero-failure evidence.
Normal final function proves no failure occurred during testing.
quiz.explanation: 零失效不是零失效率，樣本和時間限定信心。 寫出樣本數、停止規則與未發現失效的界限。
quiz.explanationEn: Zero observed failures is not zero failure rate; sample/time limit confidence. Record sample count, stopping rule and limits of zero-failure evidence.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Interim reads reveal drift; endpoint-only checks can miss transient failures. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Compare leakage, resistance and functional trends over time. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.

courses.title: 醫療電子隔離電源
courses.titleEn: Isolated power supplies for medical electronics
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究隔離屏障、漏電與系統安全證據；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate isolation barriers, leakage and system safety evidence. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設隔離電容 100 pF、230 Vrms、50 Hz，理想電容電流約 7.23 µA；它不是完整產品患者漏電結果。
workedExample.textEn: For 100 pF across 230 Vrms at 50 Hz, ideal capacitive current is about 7.23 µA; this is not a complete product patient-leakage result.
workedExample.assumptions: 單一理想電容與正弦電压；實際測試需適用標準、設備分類與合格實驗室。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: One ideal capacitor and sinusoidal voltage; actual testing needs applicable standards, equipment classification and a qualified lab.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

courses.title: LED 固態照明驅動
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究恆流、調光與熱光耦合；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate constant current, dimming and electrothermal coupling. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 教學感測基準 0.10 V、電阻 0.286 Ω，電流約 0.350 A；電阻耗散約 0.035 W，仍須查容差和降額。
workedExample.textEn: For an assumed 0.10 V sense reference and 0.286 Ω resistor, current is about 0.350 A; resistor dissipation is about 0.035 W, before tolerance/derating checks.
workedExample.assumptions: 理想穩態恆流近似；實際基準、峰值／平均控制定義依器件資料表。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Ideal steady current approximation; actual reference and peak/average control depend on the device.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

courses.title: 電子紙顯示驅動系統
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究電泳、雙穩態與更新波形；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate electrophoresis, bistability and update waveforms. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設每次更新 0.20 J、每分鐘一次，平均更新功率約 3.33 mW；若其餘電路待機 1 mW，總平均約 4.33 mW。
workedExample.textEn: At an assumed 0.20 J/update and one update/minute, average update power is about 3.33 mW; adding 1 mW electronics standby gives about 4.33 mW.
workedExample.assumptions: 能量為假設，需按實際顯示尺寸、內容、波形與溫度量測；雙穩態不表示整機零待機。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Assumed energy; measure actual size, content, waveform and temperature. Bistability does not imply zero whole-device standby.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

courses.title: OLED 顯示模組整合
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究自發光像素、供電與顯示補償；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate emissive pixels, power and display compensation. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 教學 1920×1080、60 fps、24 bit/pixel，有效畫面資料率約 2.986 Gbit/s；實際介面需求還需額外開銷。
workedExample.textEn: For 1920×1080 at 60 fps and 24 bits/pixel, active-image data rate is about 2.986 Gbit/s; real interfaces need additional overhead.
workedExample.assumptions: 未壓縮 RGB 示例；實際面板可能壓縮、變動刷新或不同子像素排列。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Uncompressed RGB example; panels may use compression, variable refresh or different subpixel arrangements.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

steps.title: 資料介面：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「資料介面」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in data interface, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。建立像素率到每通道線速率的換算。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「畫面位元率不是實體串列線速率，需算編碼和消隱。」和待排除假說「有效畫面資料率就是全部介面需求。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Convert pixel rate to per-lane line rate. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Image bit rate is not physical line rate; include coding and blanking.” with the hypothesis to reject “Active-image data rate is the entire interface requirement.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：建立像素率到每通道線速率的換算。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Convert pixel rate to per-lane line rate. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 建立像素率到每通道線速率的換算。
steps.observationEn: Convert pixel rate to per-lane line rate.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：有效畫面資料率就是全部介面需求。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Active-image data rate is the entire interface requirement. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

quiz.question: 審查「亮度與功耗」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for brightness and power?
options: OLED 功耗只由解析度决定。
自發光顯示功耗依畫面內容及亮度分布改變。
顯示模組不需要考慮局部熱點。
optionsEn: OLED power depends only on resolution.
Emissive-display power varies with image content and luminance distribution.
Display modules need no local-hotspot analysis.
quiz.explanation: 自發光顯示功耗依畫面內容及亮度分布改變。 比較同峰值亮度的全白和小白窗。
quiz.explanationEn: Emissive-display power varies with image content and luminance distribution. Compare full white and a small white window at equal peak luminance.

steps.title: 亮度與功耗：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Brightness and power: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「亮度與功耗」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in brightness and power, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。比較同峰值亮度的全白和小白窗。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「自發光顯示功耗依畫面內容及亮度分布改變。」和待排除假說「OLED 功耗只由解析度决定。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Compare full white and a small white window at equal peak luminance. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Emissive-display power varies with image content and luminance distribution.” with the hypothesis to reject “OLED power depends only on resolution.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：比較同峰值亮度的全白和小白窗。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Compare full white and a small white window at equal peak luminance. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 比較同峰值亮度的全白和小白窗。
steps.observationEn: Compare full white and a small white window at equal peak luminance.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：OLED 功耗只由解析度决定。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: OLED power depends only on resolution. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

courses.title: 觸控面板電容感測
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究自容、互容與抗干擾判讀；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate self/mutual capacitance and interference discrimination. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假想觸摸差值 120 count、未觸摸 RMS 雜訊 10 count，SNR=12（約 21.6 dB）；仍需指定頻寬與資料窗。
workedExample.textEn: Assumed touch delta 120 counts and untouched RMS noise 10 counts give SNR=12, about 21.6 dB; bandwidth and record window still need definition.
workedExample.assumptions: 控制器計數只是相對量，不能跨裝置直接當皮法；範例不是辨識門檻。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Controller counts are relative and not directly picofarads across devices; this example is not a detection threshold.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

quiz.question: 審查「互電容」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for mutual capacitance?
options: 觸摸一定讓任何感測法的原始值增加。
所有玻璃厚度都有相同靈敏度。
互容觀察 Tx 與 Rx 之間耦合，與自容方向不必相同。
optionsEn: Touch necessarily increases every sensing method's raw value.
All glass thicknesses give equal sensitivity.
Mutual sensing observes Tx/Rx coupling; change need not match self-capacitance direction.
quiz.explanation: 互容觀察 Tx 與 Rx 之間耦合，與自容方向不必相同。 比較手指介入前後場線和耦合。
quiz.explanationEn: Mutual sensing observes Tx/Rx coupling; change need not match self-capacitance direction. Compare fields/coupling before and after touch.

steps.title: 互電容：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「互電容」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in mutual capacitance, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。比較手指介入前後場線和耦合。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「互容觀察 Tx 與 Rx 之間耦合，與自容方向不必相同。」和待排除假說「觸摸一定讓任何感測法的原始值增加。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Compare fields/coupling before and after touch. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Mutual sensing observes Tx/Rx coupling; change need not match self-capacitance direction.” with the hypothesis to reject “Touch necessarily increases every sensing method's raw value.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：比較手指介入前後場線和耦合。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Compare fields/coupling before and after touch. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 比較手指介入前後場線和耦合。
steps.observationEn: Compare fields/coupling before and after touch.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：觸摸一定讓任何感測法的原始值增加。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Touch necessarily increases every sensing method's raw value. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

courses.title: 壓電致動器驅動電路
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究電容負載、機械共振與位移回授；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate capacitive loading, mechanical resonance and displacement feedback. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設 C=1 µF、f=1 kHz、Vpk=10 V，Ipk≈62.8 mA；這只是電容電流，未包含機械負載。
workedExample.textEn: For C=1 µF, f=1 kHz and Vpk=10 V, Ipk≈62.8 mA; this is capacitive current only, excluding mechanical load.
workedExample.assumptions: 小訊號線性電容近似；真實壓電電容、位移與耗損隨偏壓和頻率變化。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Small-signal linear-capacitance approximation; actual capacitance, displacement and loss vary with bias/frequency.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。

courses.title: 超音波換能器電子系統
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究聲電諧振、回波與飛行時間；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate electroacoustic resonance, echoes and time of flight. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設空氣聲速 343 m/s、往返時間 2.0 ms，距離 0.343 m；若誤忘除 2，結果會大一倍。
workedExample.textEn: Assuming air sound speed 343 m/s and round-trip time 2.0 ms, distance is 0.343 m; omitting division by two doubles the result.
workedExample.assumptions: 單一反射路徑與固定聲速近似；溫度、濕度、氣流和多路徑需另外評估。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Single reflection path and fixed sound speed; temperature, humidity, flow and multipath require additional assessment.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

courses.title: 工業感測器隔離通訊
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究差動匯流排、隔離與故障診斷；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate differential buses, isolation and fault diagnosis. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假設纜線 100 m、速度 2×10⁸ m/s，單程延遲 0.5 µs；1 Mbit/s 的 bit 時間 1 µs，不能忽略往返反射。
workedExample.textEn: Assuming 100 m cable at 2×10⁸ m/s, one-way delay is 0.5 µs; at 1 Mbit/s a bit lasts 1 µs, so round-trip reflections cannot be ignored.
workedExample.assumptions: 均勻傳輸線估算；可用速率還受上升時間、拓撲、收發器和協定限制。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Uniform-line estimate; usable rate also depends on rise time, topology, transceiver and protocol.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in working ratings, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。將三種額定及認證條件分欄。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「隔離耐壓、連續工作與突波不是同一規格。」和待排除假說「一分钟耐壓就是終生連續工作電壓。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Separate the three ratings and certification conditions. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Withstand, continuous working and surge ratings differ.” with the hypothesis to reject “One-minute withstand is lifetime working voltage.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：將三種額定及認證條件分欄。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Separate the three ratings and certification conditions. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 將三種額定及認證條件分欄。
steps.observationEn: Separate the three ratings and certification conditions.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：一分钟耐壓就是終生連續工作電壓。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: One-minute withstand is lifetime working voltage. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

courses.title: 日本北海道本州高壓直流連線案例
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究島嶼互聯、VSC 增建與韌性規劃；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate island interconnection, a VSC addition and resilience planning. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 以 2019 年公開新連線額定 250 kVdc、1,200 Adc 作端口核算，P=300 MW；此乘法未計換流與線路損耗。
workedExample.textEn: Using published 2019 new-link ratings of 250 kVdc and 1,200 Adc gives P=300 MW; this terminal calculation omits conversion and line losses.
workedExample.assumptions: 本例引用 2019 新北本 VSC 的歷史額定，不表示全部北海道本州連線現況或可用容量。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Uses historical ratings of the 2019 New Hokkaido-Honshu VSC link, not all current interconnection capacity or availability.
workedExample.sourceScope: 2019 年公告的端口額定核算；不表示今日可用容量。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Terminal-rating calculation from the 2019 announcement; not current availability.

courses.title: 英法海峽 IFA 互連電網案例
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究跨國互聯、海纜與容量交易；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate cross-border interconnection, subsea cables and capacity exchange. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 假想 2 GW 連線一天平均輸送 1 GW，電量 24 GWh、以額定為分母的利用率 50%；不是 IFA 的實際調度資料。
workedExample.textEn: A hypothetical 2 GW link averaging 1 GW over a day transfers 24 GWh, or 50% rated-capacity utilization; this is not actual IFA dispatch data.
workedExample.assumptions: 示例不含雙向交換與損耗；真實利用率需說明方向、淨額或絕對流量定義。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Excludes bidirectional exchange and losses; real utilization needs direction and net-versus-absolute-flow definitions.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.

knowledge.text: E=Pavg·t；負載率=E/(Prated·t)，兩者需同一時段。 示例不含雙向交換與損耗；真實利用率需說明方向、淨額或絕對流量定義。
knowledge.textEn: E=Pavg·t; utilization=E/(Prated·t), using the same period. Excludes bidirectional exchange and losses; real utilization needs direction and net-versus-absolute-flow definitions.

quiz.question: 審查「容量與能源」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for capacity versus energy?
options: 2,000 MW 就等於每天 2,000 MWh。
用一天假想流量曲線積分電量。
售出容量必然等於每小時實际潮流。
optionsEn: 2,000 MW equals 2,000 MWh per day.
Integrate a hypothetical daily flow curve.
Sold capacity necessarily equals each hour's actual flow.
quiz.explanation: MW 是可交換功率能力，MWh 是某時段交換能量。 用一天假想流量曲線積分電量。
quiz.explanationEn: MW is transfer-power capability; MWh is exchanged energy over time. Integrate a hypothetical daily flow curve.

steps.title: 市場與技術：模型與設計

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Capacity allocation and actual flows face both market and physical constraints. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Separate offered capacity, nominations and actual transfer. steps.title: 市場與技術：量測與判別

Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.

courses.title: 紐西蘭 HVDC Inter-Island 連線案例
courses.titleEn: New Zealand HVDC Inter-Island link case study
courses.summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究南北島能源互補與資產更新；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate island energy complementarity and asset renewal. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
courses.scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
courses.scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 教學某島需額外 300 MW 持續 4 小時，缺口 1.2 GWh；互聯是否可補足還取決於對端餘裕與剩餘容量。
workedExample.textEn: If an island hypothetically needs an extra 300 MW for 4 hours, the gap is 1.2 GWh; filling it also requires exporting-island surplus and available link capacity.
workedExample.assumptions: 完全是假想調度練習，並非紐西蘭電網當前負載、備援或操作指令。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Entirely hypothetical dispatch exercise, not current New Zealand load, reserve or operating instructions.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.
